title: Chronological next-session feature signal audit
method: Expanding chronological folds; each training target date strictly precedes the test block's first feature date; per-session cross-sectional Spearman rank IC.
interpretation: The strongest observed feature associations are consistently negative but very small in magnitude (absolute rank IC approximately 0.012-0.023). This is weak cross-sectional signal, not evidence of a useful forecast edge. Directional consistency alone does not establish economic significance or stable improvement over the previous-close baseline.

decision.next: Test a narrowly scoped, training-fold-only monotonic feature transformation or feature ablation against the existing baseline; preserve untouched chronological folds and compare MAPE, rank IC, directional accuracy, bias and turnover/cost sensitivity. Do not hard-code negative coefficients based only on this aggregate audit.
